title: Cosmic Knight and Star Tree
description: A female knight in ornate golden armor stands on a stone platform, reaching toward a massive gnarled tree with glowing blue eyes in its branches. Behind her, a translucent purple starry female figure emerges from an ornate golden rectangular portal floating above a nighttime fantasy city.
prompt: A female knight wearing intricate golden plate armor stands in the center, reaching her hand toward an enormous ancient tree with glowing blue eyes and twisting branches. A translucent cosmic female figure made of purple stars and nebulae emerges from a glowing golden rectangular portal behind her. Below is a glowing fantasy city with domes and spires under a starry night sky, digital painting style with rich fantasy detail
